newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Goldman to lead Energy Group sale.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Goldman to lead Energy Group sale.

text.p: LONDON, June 12 (LPC) - Goldman Sachs is arranging funding to back a prospective 3.6 billion stg bid by US utility group PacifiCorp for the UK's Energy Group, formerly known as Hanson Energy, bankers said.
Goldman is advising Pacificorp, and as such is the natural candidate to arrange the senior debt under the one-stop shopping concept pioneered by US investment banks.

The Energy Group was forced to make a Stock Exchange announcement following a sudden rise in the group's share price, and the company confirmed that discussions are in progress with PacifiCorp which could lead to a recommended cash offer.

If the proposed deal proceeds, the entire capital structure of the Energy Group will be refinanced. This will affect the 1 billion stg Hanson demerger facility, led by Chase, BZW and HSBC and the 961 million stg credit for Eastern Merchant Generation Ltd and Eastern Merchant Properties Ltd, which was guaranteed by Eastern Group and was arranged by IBJ.
